create_ocerror_model_loader: create an OCRErrorModelLoader instance with an optional checkpoint path for loading the OCR error detection model
build_distilbert_model: build a DistilBertForSequenceClassification model from a checkpoint with configurable device and dtype
run_ocr_error_detection: run OCR error detection on a list of text strings using the loaded model and tokenizer
build_tokenizer_processor: build a DistilBertTokenizer processor from a checkpoint for encoding text inputs
load_model_config: load a DistilBertConfig from a checkpoint to inspect model architecture before loading the full model
